title: Reproduction: How Life Continues
summary: Grade 9: asexual reproduction and clones, sexual reproduction in flowering plants, and human reproduction and reproductive health.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Living things pass on their characteristics by reproducing, and the way they reproduce affects the variation and survival of their species.

factual: What are the types of asexual reproduction?
conceptual: Why does sexual reproduction create variation?
How are flowers and human reproductive systems both suited to bringing gametes together?
debatable: Should reproductive health education begin earlier in schools?
